 - ADVISOR_CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_OK: The check ran and found no issue.

items.description: CheckResultHistoryItem represents a single persisted Advisor check run against a service.

id.description: Unique identifier of the history record.

batch_id.description: ID of the batch this result belongs to; all results produced by one execution share it.

check_name.description: Name of the check that ran.

category.description: Category the check belongs to (top-level grouping).

subcategory.description: Subcategory the check belongs to (second-level grouping within a category).

interval.description: AdvisorCheckInterval represents possible execution interval values for checks.

service_id.description: ID of the monitored service on which the check ran.

service_name.description: Name of the monitored service on which the check ran.

service_type.description: Type of the monitored service on which the check ran.

node_id.description: ID of the node the service runs on.

node_name.description: Name of the node the service runs on.

environment.description: Environment of the monitored service on which the check ran.

cluster.description: Cluster of the monitored service on which the check ran.

replication_set.description: Replication set of the monitored service on which the check ran.

status.description:
AdvisorCheckResultStatus represents the outcome of an Advisor check run against a service.

 - ADVISOR_CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_OK: The check ran and found no issue.
 - ADVISOR_CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_FAILED: The check ran and detected an issue.
 - ADVISOR_CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_ERROR: The check could not be executed.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the result.

description.description: Long human-readable description of the result.

read_more_url.description: URL containing information on how to resolve a detected issue.

outcome.description: Output returned by the check run (finding details or execution error).

severity.description: Severity represents severity level of the check result or alert.

is_read.description: Whether the result has been marked as read.

triggered_by.description:
AdvisorCheckTriggeredBy represents the actor that initiated an Advisor check run.

 - ADVISOR_CHECK_TRIGGERED_BY_USER: The run was started by a user via the API or UI.
 - ADVISOR_CHECK_TRIGGERED_BY_SCHEDULER: The run was started by the built-in scheduler.
